title: DistDebug-Bench: Can LLM Agents Diagnose Bugs in Distributed Systems?
title_zh: DistDebug-Bench：大语言模型智能体能诊断分布式系统中的缺陷吗？

paragraphs.en: DistDebug-Bench用120个真实分布式系统缺陷评估LLM智能体调试能力，揭示显著差距。 LLM agents show strong potential in software engineering tasks such as competitive programming and code synthesis. Existing benchmarks, however, largely focus on small-scale settings such as self-contained Python modules, leaving distributed systems, an essential class of production software, under-examined. We introduce DistDebug-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating agents' ability to diagnose complex-system failures at the code level. It curates 120 high-quality real-world bugs from 11 widely used distributed systems, spanning 5 programming languages and 10 failure patterns. Through an extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs and agents, we identify substantial gaps between current agents and real-world debugging tasks. A recurring gap is tunnel vision due to a lack of explicit reasoning structure and nondeterminism from inconsistent tool-use scope. The benchmark and evaluator are available at https://github.com/OrderLab/distdebug-bench, with agent traces and a leaderboard at https://distdebug.com.
paragraphs.zh: DistDebug-Bench用120个真实分布式系统缺陷评估LLM智能体调试能力，揭示显著差距。LLM智能体在竞技编程和代码合成等软件工程任务中展现出强大潜力。 然而，现有基准主要聚焦于自包含Python模块等小规模场景，导致分布式系统——一类重要的生产软件——的研究不足。 我们提出DistDebug-Bench，这是一个用于评估智能体在代码层面诊断复杂系统故障能力的基准。 该基准从11个广泛使用的分布式系统中精选了120个高质量真实缺陷，涵盖5种编程语言和10种故障模式。 通过对最先进的LLM和智能体的大规模评估，我们发现当前智能体与真实世界调试任务之间存在显著差距。 一个反复出现的差距是：由于缺乏显式推理结构而导致的隧道视野，以及因工具调用范围不一致而产生的非确定性。 该基准与评估器可在 https://github.com/OrderLab/distdebug-bench 获取，智能体轨迹和排行榜见 https://distdebug.com。
